title: Generous
subtitle: 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的
description: 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的

words.meaning: 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的
words.note: giving 是 generous 最直接的日常近義詞之一，強調一個人願意給別人時間、金錢、物品或幫助。它通常帶溫暖、正面的性格評價。
words.example: She is a giving person who is always ready to help others.
words.exampleZh: 她是一個樂於付出的人，總是願意幫助別人。

exercises.original: Everyone knows him as a generous person who freely gives his time and money to people in need.
exercises.zh: 大家都知道他很慷慨，會主動把時間和金錢給有需要的人。
exercises.upgrade: giving · 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的

options.explanation: self-centred = 以自我為中心。和 freely gives 相反。
giving = 樂於給予的。time and money + people in need 是直接線索。
strict = 嚴格。不是給予態度。
reserved = 保守／含蓄。和慷慨無直接關係。
careful = 小心的。不是樂於付出。
wealthy = 富有。富有不等於願意給予。

exercises.original: She has always been generous with her time, regularly mentoring younger colleagues after work.
exercises.zh: 她一直很願意付出時間，經常在下班後指導年輕同事。
exercises.upgrade: giving · 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的

options.explanation: busy = 忙碌。不能表達願意把時間給別人。
wealthy = 富有。和時間付出無關。
polite = 有禮貌。不是慷慨付出。
giving = 樂於給予。mentoring after work 是投入個人時間幫助別人。

exercises.original: The volunteers were generous with both their skills and their time during the rebuilding project.
exercises.zh: 重建項目期間，義工很慷慨地付出技能和時間。
exercises.upgrade: giving · 樂於給予的；慷慨助人的

options.explanation: giving = 樂於付出。skills and time 都是可以無私給予的資源。
wealthy = 富有。題目不是金錢。
private = 私人的／低調的。不是慷慨。

words.note: 當 generous 特別指捐錢、捐物或支持慈善事業時，可用 charitable。它比 giving 更聚焦慈善與公益。
words.example: The family is well known for its charitable donations.
words.exampleZh: 這個家庭以慈善捐款聞名。

exercises.original: The company has been generous toward local charities, donating part of its profits every year.
exercises.zh: 公司一直很支持本地慈善機構，每年都捐出部分利潤。
exercises.upgrade: charitable · 慈善的；樂善好施的

options.explanation: commercial = 商業的。不能表示捐款善意。
charitable = 慈善的。donating profits to charities 是最直接線索。
wealthy = 富有。富有不等於會捐款。
careful = 小心。不是公益行為。

exercises.original: She is generous to organisations that provide food and shelter for homeless people.
exercises.zh: 她很慷慨地支持為無家者提供食物和住宿的機構。
exercises.upgrade: charitable · 慈善的；樂善好施的

options.explanation: wealthy = 富有。不是捐助行為本身。
charitable = 樂善好施。支持 homeless charities 是典型。

exercises.original: His generous donations helped fund a new community clinic.
exercises.zh: 他的慷慨捐款幫助資助了一間新的社區診所。
exercises.upgrade: charitable · 慈善的；樂善好施的

options.explanation: careful = 小心。不是捐款性質。
wealthy = 富有。可以有錢但不捐款。
charitable = 慈善的。donations + community clinic 是標準搭配。

words.meaning: 仁慈慷慨的；懷有善意的
words.note: benevolent 較正式，強調一個人、機構或權威懷有善意，願意改善別人的處境。它不只指給錢，也包含仁慈、照顧與福祉。
words.example: The foundation was created by a benevolent donor.
words.exampleZh: 這個基金會由一位仁慈慷慨的捐助者創立。

exercises.original: The wealthy patron was generous and used much of his fortune to improve schools and hospitals.
exercises.zh: 這位富有贊助人很仁慈慷慨，把大量財富用於改善學校和醫院。
exercises.upgrade: benevolent · 仁慈慷慨的；懷有善意的

options.explanation: benevolent = 仁慈慷慨。uses fortune to improve public welfare 是典型正式語境。

exercises.original: The trust was established by a generous benefactor who wanted to improve children's lives.
exercises.zh: 這個信託由一位仁慈的捐助者成立，希望改善兒童生活。
exercises.upgrade: benevolent · 仁慈慷慨的；懷有善意的

options.explanation: wealthy only = 只是富有。不能表達希望改善兒童福祉。
benevolent = 仁慈慷慨。benefactor + improve lives 是固定語感。

exercises.original: The ruler was remembered as generous because he funded public hospitals and reduced taxes during bad harvests.
exercises.zh: 這位統治者因資助公立醫院並在歉收時減稅，而被記住為仁慈慷慨的人。
exercises.upgrade: benevolent · 仁慈慷慨的；懷有善意的

options.explanation: benevolent = 仁慈慷慨。ruler + welfare actions 是非常典型的正式用法。
selfish = 自私。和公共福祉行為相反。

words.meaning: 心胸寬大的；慷慨仁厚的
words.note: large-hearted 強調性格上的寬厚、慷慨和善意，尤其是在對別人寬容、願意幫忙或不斤斤計較時。它較文雅，也比 giving 多一點『心胸寬』的意味。
words.example: She was large-hearted enough to forgive the mistake and offer help.
words.exampleZh: 她心胸寬大，不但原諒錯誤，還主動幫忙。

exercises.original: He was generous enough to forgive the insult and still offer his rival assistance.
exercises.zh: 他心胸寬大，不但原諒侮辱，還願意幫助對手。
exercises.upgrade: large-hearted · 心胸寬大的；慷慨仁厚的

options.explanation: petty = 小器。和 forgive + help rival 相反。
strict = 嚴格。不是心胸寬大。
large-hearted = 心胸寬大。forgive an insult + help a rival 是典型。

exercises.original: Her generous nature showed when she welcomed the newcomer and made sure nobody was left out.
exercises.zh: 她的慷慨仁厚表現在主動歡迎新人，並確保沒有人被排除。
exercises.upgrade: large-hearted · 心胸寬大的；慷慨仁厚的

options.explanation: reserved = 含蓄。不是包容與善意。
large-hearted = 寬厚仁慈。welcomed newcomer + included everyone 是典型性格描述。

exercises.original: People admired him for being generous even to those who had treated him unfairly.
exercises.zh: 人們敬佩他，即使對曾不公平對待他的人也仍然很寬厚。
exercises.upgrade: large-hearted · 心胸寬大的；慷慨仁厚的

options.explanation: wealthy = 富有。不是性格善意。
large-hearted = 寬厚慷慨。kind even to unfair people 表示寬容與大度。

words.note: 當 generous 不只指物質給予，而是強調一個人心地善良、願意照顧或幫助別人時，可用 kind-hearted。它比 generous 更突出善良本身。
words.example: A kind-hearted neighbour brought food to the family.
words.exampleZh: 一位熱心鄰居給這家人送來食物。

exercises.original: Our generous neighbour regularly checks on older residents and brings them groceries.
exercises.zh: 我們那位善良熱心的鄰居經常探望長者，並替他們送日用品。
exercises.upgrade: kind-hearted · 善良熱心的；心地好的

options.explanation: kind-hearted = 心地善良。checks on older residents + brings groceries 是直接線索。
wealthy = 富有。題目重點是行動，不是財力。

exercises.original: She is generous with people who are struggling and always tries to make them feel welcome.
exercises.zh: 她對有困難的人很善良，總是努力讓他們感到受歡迎。
exercises.upgrade: kind-hearted · 善良熱心的；心地好的

options.explanation: kind-hearted = 善良熱心。people struggling + make them welcome 是典型。
reserved = 含蓄。不是幫助他人。

exercises.original: The teacher was generous and often stayed late to help students who were falling behind.
exercises.zh: 老師很善良熱心，經常留下來幫助落後的學生。
exercises.upgrade: kind-hearted · 善良熱心的；心地好的

options.explanation: wealthy = 富有。不是老師幫學生的原因。
strict = 嚴格。可能同時存在，但不是 generous 的意思。
kind-hearted = 心地善良。stayed late to help struggling students 是典型。

words.meaning: 出手大方的；慷慨給予的
words.note: open-handed 強調在金錢、禮物、款待或物資上出手大方。它很接近 generous 的『不吝嗇』意思，通常比 kind-hearted 更物質化。
words.example: He was an open-handed host who never let guests pay.
words.exampleZh: 他是一位出手大方的主人，從不讓客人付款。

exercises.original: The host was extremely generous and insisted on paying for everyone's dinner.
exercises.zh: 主人非常大方，堅持替所有人付晚餐費。
exercises.upgrade: open-handed · 出手大方的；慷慨給予的

options.explanation: private = 私人的／低調的。不是金錢大方。
reserved = 含蓄。不是金錢態度。
cautious = 謹慎。和大方給予相反。
open-handed = 出手大方。paying for everyone's dinner 是典型。

exercises.original: He is generous with gifts and rarely worries about how much they cost.
exercises.zh: 他送禮很大方，很少在意花多少錢。
exercises.upgrade: open-handed · 出手大方的；慷慨給予的

options.explanation: careful = 小心。可能和消費謹慎有關，但與題目相反。
open-handed = 出手大方。gifts + rarely worries about cost 是直接線索。

exercises.original: The club's most generous members covered the cost of the equipment themselves.
exercises.zh: 會內最慷慨的會員自行承擔了設備費用。
exercises.upgrade: open-handed · 出手大方的；慷慨給予的

options.explanation: formal = 正式。不是金錢態度。
careful = 謹慎。無法表達主動付錢。
open-handed = 出手大方。covered the cost themselves 是典型慷慨支出。

words.note: magnanimous 強調在勝利、衝突或被冒犯之後仍然寬容、大度、不報復。它是 generous 的一種較高階、正式的人格義，不主要指給錢。
words.example: She was magnanimous in victory and praised her opponent.
words.exampleZh: 她勝利後仍然很大度，還稱讚了對手。

exercises.original: After winning the election, she was generous toward her defeated opponent and praised his campaign.
exercises.zh: 勝選後，她對落敗對手非常大度，還稱讚了他的競選活動。
exercises.upgrade: magnanimous · 寬宏大量的；大度的

options.explanation: magnanimous = 寬宏大量。in victory + praise defeated opponent 是典型。
resentful = 懷恨的。和 praising opponent 相反。

exercises.original: He was generous enough to accept the apology without demanding punishment.
exercises.zh: 他很大度，接受道歉而沒有要求懲罰。
exercises.upgrade: magnanimous · 寬宏大量的；大度的

options.explanation: strict = 嚴格。若強調懲罰反而相反。
magnanimous = 大度。accept apology + no punishment 是典型寬容。

exercises.original: The captain was generous in defeat and congratulated the winning team sincerely.
exercises.zh: 隊長輸掉比賽後仍然很大度，真誠恭喜勝方。
exercises.upgrade: magnanimous · 寬宏大量的；大度的

options.explanation: magnanimous = 大度。in defeat + congratulate winner 是最典型用法之一。

words.meaning: 毫不吝嗇的；不遺餘力的
words.note: unstinting 較正式，表示在支持、讚美、時間、努力或資源上毫不吝嗇、給得很充分。常見搭配有 unstinting support / praise / generosity。
words.example: She gave the project her unstinting support.
words.exampleZh: 她毫不保留地支持這個項目。

exercises.original: The volunteers received generous support from the community throughout the campaign.
exercises.zh: 整個活動期間，義工得到社區毫不吝嗇的支持。
exercises.upgrade: unstinting · 毫不吝嗇的；不遺餘力的

options.explanation: limited = 有限的。和 generous support 相反。
formal = 正式。不是支持程度。
unstinting = 毫不吝嗇的。unstinting support 是非常固定的搭配。
reserved = 保留的。和 unstinting 相反。

exercises.original: She was generous in her praise of the junior staff and always gave credit where it was due.
exercises.zh: 她毫不吝嗇地讚揚初級員工，總會把功勞歸給應得的人。
exercises.upgrade: unstinting · 毫不吝嗇的；不遺餘力的

options.explanation: reserved = 保留。和 generous praise 相反。
careful = 小心。不是讚揚程度。
unstinting = 毫不吝嗇。unstinting in her praise 是標準搭配。

exercises.original: His generous commitment of time and energy kept the community project alive.
exercises.zh: 他毫不吝嗇地投入時間和精力，令社區項目得以維持。
exercises.upgrade: unstinting · 毫不吝嗇的；不遺餘力的

options.explanation: formal = 正式。不是投入程度。
limited = 有限。和 generous commitment 相反。
unstinting = 不遺餘力。time and energy + kept project alive 是典型。

words.meaning: 極其慷慨的；出手闊綽的（正式）
words.note: munificent 是較正式、較高階的詞，表示在捐款、禮物、資助或獎賞方面極其慷慨，通常比 generous 更強。
words.example: The museum was built with a munificent gift from a private donor.
words.exampleZh: 博物館由一位私人捐助者的巨額慷慨捐贈興建。

exercises.original: The university received a generous gift large enough to fund scholarships for decades.
exercises.zh: 大學收到一筆極其慷慨的捐款，足以資助數十年的獎學金。
exercises.upgrade: munificent · 極其慷慨的；出手闊綽的（正式）

options.explanation: modest = 不大的／謙遜的。和 fund scholarships for decades 不符。
private = 私人的。不能表達金額慷慨。
munificent = 極其慷慨。very large gift + decades of scholarships 是典型。

exercises.original: The donor made a generous contribution that paid for the entire new library.
exercises.zh: 捐助者作出極其慷慨的捐款，支付了整座新圖書館的費用。
exercises.upgrade: munificent · 極其慷慨的；出手闊綽的（正式）

options.explanation: munificent = 極其慷慨。paid for the entire new library 是巨額捐贈線索。
careful = 小心。不是捐款程度。

exercises.original: The foundation became famous for its generous grants to medical research.
exercises.zh: 這個基金會因向醫學研究提供非常慷慨的資助而聞名。
exercises.upgrade: munificent · 極其慷慨的；出手闊綽的（正式）

options.explanation: modest = 少量的。和 famous for generous grants 不符。
munificent = 極其慷慨。munificent grants 是自然正式搭配。

words.meaning: 大方的；給得多的（限特定用法）
words.note: 在 a liberal amount / a liberal helping / liberal with money 等較傳統用法中，liberal 可表示『給得大方、分量充足』。這不是政治上的 liberal，且現代日常英語中通常比 generous 更受語境限制。
words.example: The cook added a liberal amount of olive oil.
words.exampleZh: 廚師加入了相當大方的橄欖油分量。

exercises.original: The recipe calls for a generous amount of grated cheese on top.
exercises.zh: 食譜要求在上面放上相當大方的芝士分量。
exercises.upgrade: liberal · 大方的；給得多的（限特定用法）

options.explanation: minimal = 最少的。和 generous amount 相反。
liberal = 大方的／充足的。a liberal amount 是固定用法，表示分量較多。

exercises.original: The waiter served a generous helping of mashed potatoes.
exercises.zh: 侍應給了一大份薯蓉。
exercises.upgrade: liberal · 大方的；給得多的（限特定用法）

options.explanation: small = 小份。和 generous helping 相反。
liberal = 大方／充足的。liberal helping 是自然傳統搭配。

exercises.original: He was generous with the budget for staff training and approved more than the minimum requested.
exercises.zh: 他在員工培訓預算方面很大方，批准的金額高於最低要求。
exercises.upgrade: liberal · 大方的；給得多的（限特定用法）

options.explanation: minimal = 最低限度。和 more than minimum 相反。
strict = 嚴格。不能表示給錢大方。
liberal = 大方的。liberal with the budget 在『給得多』的傳統用法中成立。
careful = 小心。可能描述理財，但不是題目意思。

falseSynonyms.zh: 富有的不等於一般的 generous wealthy 只表示有很多錢；一個富有的人可以很吝嗇，而一個不富有的人也可以很 generous。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Wealth is about what you have; generosity is about what you give.

falseSynonyms.zh: 友善的不等於一般的 generous friendly 表示態度友好。友善的人未必願意付出時間、金錢或資源，因此不是一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Friendliness and generosity often coexist, but they are different qualities.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有禮貌的不等於一般的 generous polite 指符合禮貌規範；有禮貌不等於慷慨。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Politeness concerns manners; generosity concerns giving or largeness of spirit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無私的不等於一般的 generous selfless 表示把別人的需要放在自己之前；它和 generous 有重疊，但範圍不同，不能把所有 generous 行為都稱為 selfless。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Generosity can be selfless, but the two concepts are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 奢侈的；過度花費的不等於一般的 generous extravagant 表示花費或使用資源過度，通常帶負面意味；generous 可以大方但仍然合理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Generous giving need not be extravagant.

falseSynonyms.zh: 浪費的不等於一般的 generous wasteful 強調資源使用不當或不必要；慷慨給予不等於浪費。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Wastefulness is inefficient use; generosity is willing giving.

falseSynonyms.zh: 善良的不等於一般的 generous kind 和 generous 有很大重疊，但 kind 的核心是友善、體貼；不是所有善良行為都涉及給予，因此本課用更精準的 kind-hearted 作限定近義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Kindness is broader than generosity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有錢的；富有的不等於一般的 generous rich 描述財富或資源充足，不能表示一個人願不願意分享。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rich person may or may not be generous.
